items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Jackie who is living in New York... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: Well, one thing I can say, see we know so much about you, Paul, we just kind of want you to say what you remember and some of these things I'm about to say now are things that a bunch of the musicians in Los Angeles who have done quite well -- Chico Hamilton, Charlie Mingus, Jackie who is living in New York, Kelsoe, Britt Woodman, the whole Woodman family, the Woodman brothers.
